# Babes Net

> Babes Net is a global community of 800+ women in tech and Web3. IRL events and
> meet-ups all over the world, workshops, wellness activities, and an AI education
> programme.

Started in November 2025 by Camilla Parisotto and Florence Vuong, beginning with the
Babes Net key handed out in Buenos Aires during DevConnect and a first brunch in Dubai.

Membership is free. You join by filling in the membership form on the site, and a team
member follows up. No crypto or Web3 experience is needed — Babes Net is for women in tech
broadly, with a strong presence in Web3, and is open to women who want to upskill or learn
about AI through the workshops. Events are published on a public Luma calendar.

## Pages

- [Home](https://babesnet.xyz/): What Babes Net is, the cities it meets in, and the partners and companies behind it
- [Origin story](https://babesnet.xyz/about): How it began — Camilla Parisotto and Florence Vuong, the first key in Buenos Aires, the first brunch in Dubai
- [Camilla Parisotto](https://babesnet.xyz/camilla-parisotto): Co-founder — Bloomberg, then the NYC AI startup NEA, then the creative agency Mood Labs
- [Florence Vuong](https://babesnet.xyz/florence-vuong): Co-founder — years in ecommerce, founder of the merch studio OriginalCopy, former COO of Chipped
- [Events](https://babesnet.xyz/events): Upcoming and past events — brunches, workshops, panels and wellness sessions, worldwide
- [FAQ](https://babesnet.xyz/faq): Joining, what members get, city chapters, partnerships, and how to get in touch

## Elsewhere

## Optional

- [Privacy](https://babesnet.xyz/privacy): What is collected, why, and how to have it deleted. No advertising cookies, no cross-site tracking, nothing sold
